activities.name: last_cdc
activities.description: Fetches the cdc_timestamp from the cdc.json file

activities.name: TotalResult
activities.description: Verifies the count of records that are added/updated post the last run and only triggers the copying of records if count>0

text.value: SELECT count(*) as total_count FROM @{pipeline().parameters.schema}.@{pipeline().parameters.table} WHERE last_updated > '@{if(empty(pipeline().parameters.backdate), activity('last_cdc').output.value[0].cdc_timestamp, pipeline().parameters.backdate)}'

ifTrueActivities.name: Load
ifTrueActivities.description: Copies the data from the table to parquet file

ifTrueActivities.name: change_cdc
ifTrueActivities.description: This activity overwrites the value in cdc.json file by latest last_updated timestamp as per the values passed to schema & table parameters

ifTrueActivities.name: max_cdc
ifTrueActivities.description: This activity fetches the latest last_updated timestamp from the recent batch of copied records
